week.label: Week of Oct 22 – 28, 2026
week.source: Matt Croom's Daily Compliance Review (received 10/29) — Oct 22–27 fully audited; 10/28 about 25% audited. 374 job-days. Top performers ranked among techs with 3+ audited shifts.
week.bottomLine: The best week since weekly tracking began in September. Day forms hit 97% and trailer inspections 98%, missed forms fell from 57 to 25, and no false PPE, backdated or undated paperwork was flagged. The one gap: trailer readiness slipped to 73%, with SM Energy at 53%.
week.segments: By segment, day forms: XTO 99.3% (149/150) · WTX 97.4% · ETX 96.6% (was 75%) · Comstock 100% (was 54%) · SM Energy 92.5% · air jobs 98.8% · supervision jobs 87.5% (was 78%). Readiness: XTO 80.0% (36/45) · SM Energy 53.3% (8/15).

concerns.t: Trailer readiness — the only form that went backwards
concerns.d: 44 of 60 (73.3%), down from 86%. It has swung 82% → 71% → 86% → 73% over four weeks, so it isn't sticking and needs a process fix (a checkpoint at dispatch or a StreetSmart prompt on every trailer move). SM Energy 8 of 15 (53%): Caleb Smith, Brianda Sandoval, Kirschke and Flores, Jobe and Bailey, Clubb. XTO 36 of 45 (80%): Jimmy White (2), Gage Gonzales, Zarate and McCarter, Jobe and Avila, Norris and Sanders.

Josh Blassingame: no JSA on three jobs 10/27 (City of Tyler and XTO; called and reminded), and on one XTO job StreetSmart listed 6 SCBAs on site but he said only 2 were there. Also no daily inspection 10/24. Crew-wide: a JSA on every job, including short and field-service jobs, and equipment counts in StreetSmart must match what's on site.

Benjamin Boutte: night daily inspections missed 10/23 and 10/25 (2 of 4). Brey Rasco: no daily inspection 10/26 (1 of 3) — third report running on the list, though no undated-JSA flags this week. Michael Jobe (10/26) and Hayden Haugh (10/26, his only miss, down from 3).

Gage Gonzales: no Exxon JSA or atmospheric testing log 10/22 (the auditor moved them over from Jerry's job); reported his job deleted 10/27 — confirm the paperwork was uploaded. Bryan Medlin's readiness photos didn't come through 10/27 (says the form was done; waiting on photos). BJ Caesar had no StreetSmart access 10/27.

SCBA out of hydro (Kirschke, SM Energy, 10/23) · SCBA count discrepancy on Blassingame's XTO job (10/27). Still open from prior weeks: Forbes's SABA/SCBA hydro (BPX), Ovintiv sensor batteries and dead sensors, SM workpack hydro, and White's fire extinguisher, which expires 10/31.
Night forms 3 of 5 — a small sample, but both misses are Boutte's. Finish the 10/28 audits (about 25% done).

ytd.label: 2026 Year-to-Date (Jan 1 – Sep 30)
ytd.note: 273 daily tabs, 13,595 job-days. Only about half of job-days were audited YTD — and fewer than a third before June — so these are misses that were FOUND, not every miss.
standouts: Night forms have fallen from ~89% in January to 44% in September. Trailer readiness has fallen too — from nearly 100% through May to ~70% since June.
By customer: XTO has the highest day-form rate at 95%. Ovintiv (66%) and Southwest Operating (55%) have the lowest.
Coverage rose above 90% in July and August, then dropped to 55% in September — early-month percentages rest on small samples.
